[[File:A_Call_to_Reason.jpg|thumb|The pamphlet ''A Call To Reason'' was printed on synth-paper]]
'''Synth-paper''' was a type of synthetic [[Paper/Legends|paper]]-like material that was used as stationery during the height of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] pamphlet ''[[A Call to Reason]]'', written by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] in the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], was printed on synth-paper to evoke nostalgia for an idealized past.
